quotes.text: It's all about finding those efficiencies. We've cut the red tape in doing those things. I've done what Kansas wants to have done in their state government — I've already done that as being Insurance Commissioner. So, I would start looking for those efficiencies from top to bottom, ask our employees what they think can be done to be more efficient, and go from there.
quotes.editor_note: Verbatim, one contiguous paragraph, from KCTV5's 'Kansas Governor Candidate Guide' — an on-record video Q&A KCTV5 ran with all 10 candidates, published as a written transcript without a per-clip timestamp (tier 2, news interview); a run-on clause was split into two sentences and a leading 'And so, to me,' filler dropped, no substance changed. Flagging for a human reviewer that this leans heavily on her Insurance Commissioner record before reaching the forward pledge in the last sentence — the thinnest operative-clause case staged in this race; her only other on-record material (farmers/Chiefs segments of the same series) was even more retrospective or noncommittal, so this was the strongest forward statement found for her this pass. No Compass stance on file yet for this new candidate.
